steps.task: Implement native archaeology supervisor runtime and CLI.
requirements: Load external campaign/task and route ledgers; persist append-only events and atomic checkpoints under an external state root.
Compute dependency-ready tasks and choose least-scarce qualified route after capability/privacy/exact-route/independence filters.
Capacity bands when observed percentage exists: GREEN <70, YELLOW 70-85, RED 85-95, CRITICAL >=95; UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN.
Pre-dispatch capacity diversion allowed; terminal capacity failure creates distinct successor attempt; never mutate original attempt into success.
Runner invocation uses argv with shell=False; terminal receipt is written by a wrapper process independently of supervisor lifetime.
CLI surfaces: validate, init, status, run, probe; run supports --once and finite --max-dispatch.
Probe executable/version and safe metadata/catalog only; OpenCode model catalog is metadata-only and does not invoke inference.
Do not invent provider quota APIs/selectors and do not emit secrets.
validation: Unit tests cover scheduling, hard filters, capacity bands, premium reserve, diversion, explicit successor attempts, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN reconciliation, atomic state, and shell-free commands.
CLI help and schema validation pass.
